app.name: HeatSafe Student
app.demoGuidance: Demo guidance only. Weather information is not real-time.

header.tripleZero: Call Triple Zero (000) if someone may be seriously unwell.

heatRisk.title: Heat Risk
heatRisk.intro: Live local forecast and personalised heat guidance.
heatRisk.source: Forecast data provided by Open-Meteo. Heat guidance is not an official warning.
heatRisk.unavailableTitle: We couldn’t update the weather right now.
heatRisk.chartSummary: The chart compares forecast air temperature with apparent temperature from morning to evening. The highest apparent temperature is {{temp}}.
heatRisk.similarEvening: Temperatures may remain similar this evening. Carry water and consider a cool indoor rest location.
heatRisk.basedOnFeels: Warmest periods are based on live apparent temperature.
heatRisk.selectCircumstances: Select one or more circumstances to see personalised safety suggestions.

message.comfortable: Conditions are currently comfortable. Normal care is usually enough.
message.warm: Warm conditions today. Plan water, shade and comfortable travel times.
message.hot: Hot conditions are expected. Avoid long outdoor periods during the warmest hours.
message.very-hot: Very hot conditions are expected. Change outdoor plans where possible and prepare a cooler place.

advice.comfortable: Keep water nearby and enjoy your day with normal care.
advice.warm: Carry water, use sunscreen, wear light clothing and choose shade when you can.
advice.hot: Consider shorter outdoor trips, cooler rest stops and a later travel time.
advice.very-hot: Prepare water, cooling options, transport plans and check in with friends.

coolPlaces.title: Cool Places
coolPlaces.description: Find air-conditioned spaces, water access, and transport-friendly demo stops.
coolPlaces.disclaimer: Cooling places shown in this prototype are demonstration locations and have not been independently verified.
coolPlaces.emptyTitle: No demo cooling places match these filters.
coolPlaces.emptyBody: Try removing one of the filters.
coolPlaces.directionsBody: This is a demonstration location used for the prototype. Would you like to preview directions to its map coordinates?
coolPlaces.locationDenied: Location access was not enabled. The map is showing central Melbourne.
